sentences.en: Huh? My neck feels weird. It seems I slept funny.
sentences.zh: 嘿？我的脖子感觉怪怪的。看来我睡得不太对。

sentences.en: There are lots of four-character compound words in Japanese, huh?
sentences.zh: 日语里有很多四字成语，是吧？

sentences.en: Huh? What is this? They're not going to use my proposal?
sentences.zh: 什么？这是什么东西？他们不打算用我的提案吗？

senses.zh: 嘿（表示疑问、惊讶或异议）
